excerpt.zh: 一块铝板被发现于[From.GetName]周围漂浮的碎石中，它的阳极化表面使它从周围的金属残骸中脱颖而出。它上面绘有两只模样滑稽的哺乳动物，还有一些无趣的几何形状。
excerpt.en: An aluminum plaque is found drifting among the detritus around [From.GetName], its anodized surface standing out from the metal debris surrounding it. It depicts two ridiculous-looking mammalian figures and some rather tasteless geometric shapes.

texts.zh: 一块铝板被发现于[From.GetName]周围漂浮的碎石中，它的阳极化表面使它从周围的金属残骸中脱颖而出。它上面绘有两只模样滑稽的哺乳动物，还有一些无趣的几何形状。
texts.en: An aluminum plaque is found drifting among the detritus around [From.GetName], its anodized surface standing out from the metal debris surrounding it. It depicts two ridiculous-looking mammalian figures and some rather tasteless geometric shapes.

label.zh: 也许可以当我酒杯的杯垫。
label.en: It might make a good coaster for my drink.

label.zh: 肯定有人愿意出价购买。
label.en: I'm sure someone would be willing to pay for it.

texts.zh:
铝板上雕刻的坐标大体准确。

这是太阳系，而这块铝板显然来自被我们宇航员标记为太阳系-III的那颗行星。
texts.en:
The directions inferred from the inscribed plaque were largely accurate.

This is the system of Sol, with the plaque apparently originating from the planet our astronomers have labeled Sol III.

texts.zh: 我们已经找到了那些可疑破旧金属废料的源头。太阳系是一个以一颗黄矮星为中心的小星系，一个和[Root.Owner.GetName]的辉煌毫不相称的穷乡僻壤。
texts.en: We have found the alleged source of the tacky metal scrap we recovered. The system of Sol is a pinprick in space centered on a pitiful yellow dwarf, a backwater completely eclipsed by the splendor of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们最终到达了太阳系，那里的人在沥尽心血地用极其原始的方式与外界交流。铝板所标记的源头似乎是从恒星往外数第三块岩石，应该是一颗大陆行星。
texts.en: We have finally reached the system of Sol, a destination some being went to great pains to communicate through a very primitive medium. The plaque's point of origin is seemingly the third rock from the sun, which should be a continental planet.

label.zh: 发表声明。然后把铝板丢到他们的恒星里去。
label.en: Make a statement. Jettison the plaque into their sun.

label.zh: 你们向虚空呼唤，我们便来了。
label.en: You shouted into the void, and we came.

texts.zh: 一块阳极镀金的铝板被发现于[From.GetName]的表面。在进行任何分析和数据对比之前，[Root.GetName]上的所有成员就已经认识到了它的来源。
texts.en: An aluminum plate, anodized gold, is recovered from the surface of [From.GetName]. Everyone aboard the [Root.GetName] recognize it long before analysis and database cross-referencing confirm its origins.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在调查[From.GetName]微弱引力场时发现了一张金色碟片。碟片已被收回，初步分析表明其表面的细槽可能是由某种外星文明所创作的经过加密的音频和视频数据。
texts.en: A golden disc strikes the forward viewport of the [Root.GetName] as it is surveying the weak gravitational field of [From.GetName]. The object is recovered, and cursory analysis indicates that the minuscule grooves on the disc's surface might be encoded audio and video data, authored by some alien civilization.

label.zh: 也许可以当大酒杯的杯垫。
label.en: It might make a good coaster for a very big drink.

label.zh: 外星音乐爱好者肯定会出大价钱。
label.en: Xeno-audiophiles would pay a lot for this.

texts.zh:
碟片上刻录的坐标大体准确。

这是太阳系，而这块碟片显然来自被我们宇航员标记为太阳系-III的那颗行星。
texts.en:
The directions inferred from the audiovisual record were largely accurate.

This is the system of Sol, with the disc apparently originating from the planet our astronomers have labeled Sol III.

texts.zh: 我们找到了那张被我们修复的破旧的光盘的可能的来源。只是这个星系在太空实在是太过于渺小了，以一颗可怜的黄矮星为中心。在壮丽的[Root.Owner.GetName]面前，这只是一个根本不值得一提的蛮荒之地。
texts.en: We have found the alleged source of the tacky disc we recovered. The system of Sol is a pinprick in space centered on a pitiful yellow dwarf, a backwater completely eclipsed by the splendor of the [Root.Owner.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们最终到达了太阳系，一些生物通过很原始的媒介艰难的通讯的地方。这块徽章的来源看起来是太阳的第三颗行星，那是一个大陆行星。
texts.en: We have finally reached the system of Sol, a destination some being went to great pains to communicate through a very primitive medium. The disc's point of origin is seemingly the third rock from the sun, which should be a continental planet.

label.zh: 发出声明。把碟片丢到他们的恒星里去。
label.en: Make a statement. Jettison the record into their sun.

label.zh: 你们向虚空呼唤，我们便来了。
label.en: You shouted into the void, and we came.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]表面一座被早已逝去的[Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]民族所抛弃的堡垒内，一张金色碟片静躺在一座石台上，被厚厚的孢子尘埃覆盖着。

起初它被认为是一件微不足道的外星制品，可能有着某种宗教意义，但一台档案计算机很快辨识出它是当初旅行者号探测器发射时携带的镀金唱片。
texts.en:
In an abandoned fortress on the surface of [From.GetName], evidently the stronghold of some long-dead race of [Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural], a golden disc rests on a pedestal beneath a thick covering of spore-dust.

First designated to be stowed away as an alien artifact of minor, possibly xeno-religious significance, an archival computer soon identifies it as the golden phonograph record originally launched with the Voyager probe.

texts.zh: 一件外星人文物提供了一个特定星系的坐标。
texts.en: An alien artifact provides the coordinates for a particular system.
